CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Friday, April 8, 2022
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Special Meeting, 5:30 PM

Maria Teresa Del Rio, Mayor Pro Tem
Jesse Alvarado, Council Member  Ernesto Marquez,City Manager
Victor Farfan, Council Member  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
Mike Gomez, Council Member  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk
  Luis Roa, Mayor

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The City Council special meeting was called to order on Tuesday, April 8, 2022 at 6:05 PM.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, provided brief information regarding the conduct of the meeting.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Mayor Roa
  Councilmember Farfan
  Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio
  Councilmember Alvarado
  Councilmember Gomez
ABSENT
  None

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

PRESENTATIONS

1.  Presentation by Yolanda Mayela Macias Hernandez, Municipal President of our Sister City,
  Venustiano Carranza, Michoacan.

  SUGGESTED ACTION:

  Mayor Roa spoke.

  Yolanda Mayela Macias Hernandez, Municipal President of our Sister City, Venustiano Carranza,
  spoke; and provided a PowerPoint presentation.

  Ivan Maravilla Ramirez, Public Works Director of our Sister City, Venustiano Carranza, spoke; and
  continued the PowerPoint presentation.
